sentences.text: The name Prenoceratops means 'bent or prone-horned face' and comes from Greek words for bent, horn, and face.
Prenoceratops was a small dinosaur that grew to about 1.3 meters long and weighed 20 kilograms.
Prenoceratops measured approximately 1.50 meters in length and 70 centimeters in height.
The genus Prenoceratops was named by Chinnery in 2004.
Prenoceratops was first discovered on a Blackfeet reservation in Pondera County, Montana.
The holotype specimen, designated TCM 2003.1.1, includes a surangular fused with an articular.
Brenda J. Chinnery described Prenoceratops in 2004.
An isolated right frontal bone from the Oldman Formation in Alberta was described in 2010 and assigned to Prenoceratops.
Prenoceratops was a herbivore.
Because flowering plants were geographically limited during the Cretaceous, Prenoceratops likely fed on ferns, cycads, and conifers.
Prenoceratops used its sharp beak to bite off leaves or needles.
Prenoceratops had a wide, thick skull with a parrot-like beak used to cut ferns, cycads, and conifers, which it then chewed with its back teeth.
The only known species of Prenoceratops is P. pieganensis.
Prenoceratops is closely related to Leptoceratops and lived several million years before it.
Prenoceratops pieganensis belongs to the family Leptoceratopsidae.
Prenoceratops lived during the Late Cretaceous Period.
Fossils of Prenoceratops were found in the Campanian-age Two Medicine Formation in Montana, dating to 74.3 million years ago.
Fossils of Prenoceratops were also found in the Oldman Formation in Alberta, Canada, dating to around 77 million years ago.
Prenoceratops pieganensis lived during the Upper Cretaceous.
Prenoceratops pieganensis lived at the end of the Cretaceous Period, approximately 74 million years ago, in what is now North America.
The time range for Prenoceratops is estimated from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
